description: This file defines the LeaveCommentDecorator class for augmenting and managing LeaveComment entities within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to associate comments with employees, users, and leaves, as well as formatting created timestamp data.

classes.name: LeaveCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveComment entity providing methods to associate related entities and format creation timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Links an Employee entity to the leave comment based on employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Links a User entity to the leave comment based on user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveById
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity to the leave comment based on leave ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as 'H:i'.
